parsed.why: No criminalisation, no documented targeting or border friction for trans visitors; protections and stigma are orientation-based and thin-sourced. No visitor-facing exposure documented, but no acceptance record either — moderate unknowns, low documented severity.

In-force gender-identity workplace and media protections, non-surgical document recognition, rising acceptance and policed pride, against dated police impunity, religious hostility and male-marker border stops. Protections outweigh hostile drafts and gatekeeping.

State hostility in force: education law barring gender-identity promotion, constitutional LGR ban, failed hate-crime investigation, plus survey showing 46% avoid places and only 27% are open. Hostile law and society aligned; no documented visitor protections.

Police raids with beatings, forced examinations, blackmail and imprisonment (2017, 2023), trans murder with inadequate investigation, zero protections, 77% hostile media, ranked region's last. State-tolerated targeting is recurring, high-severity, traveller-reachable.

Decriminalised, society described as relatively tolerant, no targeting documented — but total absence of protections or recognition, dated thin data, and impunity-riddled rule of law that would leave an outed visitor without remedy.
